findings.issue: Turns 21–23 are extended speculation about hidden tests (flash of wrong label, bfcache, stale storage) that never produces a check — reasoning without evidence
findings.suggestion: Convert each concern into either a quick browser probe or a concrete assertion, or drop it

summary: A model planning session: the agent read the feature, spec, tests, fixtures and existing code before writing anything, then implemented in dependency order and passed the full 63-test suite on its first run with zero fix cycles. The weaknesses are a three-turn self-inflicted loop of careless edit calls and verification that never extends beyond the test suite and build to actually looking at the new team page in a browser. Overall an efficient, high-quality process with minor tool sloppiness and a slightly thin verification tail.
